messages:
Nina P: Hi @people-ops 1m in a bit of a bind. My kid9s daycare unexpectedly closed for two weeks and I need to be home evenings. I9m on the weekend on-call rotation this month. Can we request a temporary on-call reassignment or a partial exemption? Prefer this stays confidential.

Omar (People Ops): Hi Nina 109m really sorry to hear that. We can open a short-term accommodation case. Quick Qs: how long do you need the change (dates), would you prefer a full swap of your weekend(s) or an exemption from late-night pager duties, and do you want us to coordinate swaps with the on-call team or route it through your manager?

Nina P: Thanks Omar. I need coverage for the next two weekends (May 300 and May 1001). Prefer full swap if possible so I don9t get woken up. Please keep details private; manager can be told "temporary on-call adjustment approved".

OncallBot: :white_check_mark: Automatic check: Nina P oncall entries found for 2026-05-03 and 2026-05-10. Eligible swap window open.

Devon (Eng Manager): Nina 129I support this. We can reassign your weekends and notate coverage. If People Ops needs me to approve any performance exclusions, I will. I9ll hold your sprint items so nobody expects deep-focus work those mornings.

Liam (oncall coordinator): I can take one of those weekends and ask the on-call pool to pick up the other. Will ping the rotation list and try to confirm swaps within today. If no volunteers, we have a backlog of volunteers who take paid swap credits.

Omar (People Ops): Opening confidential case AC-2026-3001. Process: 1) employee fills brief intake (reason optional) 2) People Ops logs interim accommodations and coordinates coverage 3) manager acknowledges high-level change 4) we exclude affected shifts from on-call performance metrics if needed. I can DM you the intake link now.

Nina P: Form received and submitted (reason redacted). Please do not include medical/family details in calendar invites or team notes. "Temporary on-call reassignment approved" is fine.

OncallBot: Update: AC-2026-3001 linked to on-call schedule.

Liam (oncall coordinator): Swap confirmed: Liam -> 2026-05-03, Volunteer (TBD) -> 2026-05-10. I9ll update the rota and send the minimal notification: "Nina P: weekend on-call reassignment approved (confidential)."

Devon (Eng Manager): I've updated sprint assignments and removed Nina from any late-night interview panels for those weeks. If there are any notebookable performance metrics affected, we'll mark them as excluded in the weekly report.

Nina P: Thank you all 129I really appreciate the quick help and privacy. I9ll keep you posted if I need to extend.

Omar (People Ops): Noted 129we'll check in in 10 days to see if extension needed. Case AC-2026-3001 will stay confidential.

OncallBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 10 days for AC-2026-3001.
